thread:
Priya (oncall): seeing a spike of 502/504s for hosted inference across eu-west-1, started ~10:03 UTC. Dashboard shows gateway errors upstream of runtime nodes. :eyes:
Alex (deploy): thanks, grabbing deployment timeline. I pushed a staged route-config flip 10:00 UTC targeting 10% traffic to v2 routing-rule.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: release/2026-03-17-route-swap at 10:00:12 UTC — staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%
Sam (infra): metric snapshot: 5xx rate increased ~x6 for the next-hop proxy cluster that handles routing to runtime variants. TCP latencies ok, but proxy returns 502/504.
Elena (support): multiple customer escalations about timeouts and 502s in last 8 minutes, some with high QPS. PTRs attach logs.
Priya (oncall): can we quickly confirm if the v2 variant accepts the same trace/header and auth paths? suspect config flag mismatch on routing metadata.
Alex (deploy): I added a route-tag header to route to v2 (`x-route-tag: beta`) — older proxies expect `x-route` key. my bad, config mismatch. rolling back now.
Sam (infra): if proxies can't match header they fallback to proxy passthrough which returns 502 for requests that need model affinity. I see header mismatch metric jump at 10:01:05.
Priya (oncall): rollback plan: stop rollout -> pin traffic back to v1 -> revert flag at control-plane. Alex, can you do the stop?
Alex (deploy): running: `orchctl rollout pause release/2026-03-17-route-swap`
Alex (deploy): paused at 10:04:02. Now executing: `orchctl rollback --release release/2026-03-17-route-swap --to-tag v1`
Elena (support): sending customers a quick note: "We observed a transient routing regression impacting a subset of inference requests; root cause under investigation, rolling back staged change."
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by Alex at 10:04:06 — targeting immediate route pin to v1 for eu-west-1
Sam (infra): after pause and rollback command, 5xx starts to drop around 10:06:30 but there are lingering backend timeouts for in-flight requests. Cache invalidation in edge proxies may take up to 30s.
Priya (oncall): status check: error budget alerts still firing but trending down. Can we confirm auth token parsing compatibility?
Alex (deploy): v2 expects jwt in `authorization` plain; v1 allowed `x-auth` fallback. I accidentally removed the fallback in the config template when I added the route-tag. That explains 401->502 proxy behavior. rolling full revert of template now.
Sam (infra): snapshot of tail logs from gateway:
```
2026-03-17T10:02:10Z gateway ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream=runtime-variant-v2 reason="missing header x-route" status=502
2026-03-17T10:02:11Z gateway WARN request_id=abc124 upstream=runtime-variant-v2 auth=failed fallback=none
```
Priya (oncall): good capture. Alex, confirm revert applied and we should let traffic settle. Also please patch the rollout job to include a traffic-rollback hook next time.
Alex (deploy): revert applied at 10:07:12. Orchestrator shows stable routes pinned to v1. Adding a pre-flight config check to the rollout job now.
Elena (support): customer-facing update: "Change deployed to 10% traffic created a routing header mismatch causing transient 502/504s in eu-west-1. We've rolled back and are monitoring. Apologies for the interruption."
Diego (billing): any customers hit with quota/billing anomalies? We saw a couple of requests retried that might inflate tokens. Need list for credits.
Priya (oncall): please collect request_id list for retry storms and we'll coordinate credits. Sam, can you pull proxy logs with `status in (502,504)` and include request ids?
Sam (infra): running query now, will dump to secure S3 bucket and share link.
Alex (deploy): follow-up actions: 1) add preflight header compatibility test to rollout job 2) add canary runbook step to validate header parity 3) patch config-template to retain legacy auth fallback 4) postmortem owner = Alex.
Priya (oncall): I'll own incident timeline and communications. tagging in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rb-012-routing-mismatch
Elena (support): I've opened support tickets with affected customers and linked the runbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment release/2026-03-17-route-swap status: rolled back -> stable at 10:08:13
Priya (oncall): monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline by 10:09:30. Marking incident as mitigated. Will leave the channel open for postmortem items. :white_check_mark:
Alex (deploy): apologies for the rush deploy, taking post-incident checklist.
Diego (billing): collecting retry list, will send CSV for credits if needed.
Elena (support): closing customer P1 notifications, will add note to tickets.
Priya (oncall): thanks everyone — next steps: postmortem draft in 24h, include timeline, root cause (route header key mismatch + missing fallback), remediation (preflight tests + rollout hook), and billing impact.
Sam (infra): +1 on adding automated canary header parity test. I'll add infra guardrail ticket.
Alex (deploy): assigning myself as postmortem author, will include diff that introduced header rename.
Priya (oncall): Incident mitigated. If anything new pops up, re-open thread."
